Cleanup verified (no stray procs/tmux; real ~/.cc-runtime/state.db sha f6194418… == baseline; real ~/.cc-orchestrate has no state.db).

GATED live tool-list re-run (accepts reduced isolation + token spend): install both plugins into a HOME, launch a real claude with the composed argv from rec/spawn-rec.txt (real ccp), read the session transcript's system-init tool list — assert cco channel tools + ask/notify present, Workflow present, native AskUserQuestion/PushNotification absent. Slotting into P7.

Root cause of E2E attempt 1's death: claudeInvocation prefers `ccp` on PATH → real Claude launched and spent/died; this run shadowed ccp with a zero-token recorder. Also: macOS lacks setsid(1); the harness detached via python os.setsid and evaluated via fish (bash mangled the quoting).
